_comment: Loaded at server startup from EXAMOS_RELEASES_CONFIG env var,
The registry is intentionally empty until real signed release measurements are provisioned.
Production mode refuses this file: production requires an externally
signed registry, APPROVED_PRODUCTION entries, a non-placeholder signed
UKI hash, and complete SHA-256 PCR measurements from a controlled boot.
revoked: set to true to prevent any new attestations with this release.
Active sessions will fail their next re-attestation heartbeat.
